step1_analysis.circuit_type: PWM Delay Cell / Current-Starved NAND Gate
step1_analysis.description: A high-speed pseudo-NMOS NAND gate with a diode-connected PMOS load and a PMOS current source. It is likely used as a variable delay element in a pulse-width modulation (PWM) generator, where the bias voltage VBP controls the pull-up current and thus the rising edge delay.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS 400-Mb/s Serial Link for AS-Memory Systems Using a PWM Scheme

sky130_expected.calculation: When pull-down is off, XM4 (current source) pulls N1 to VDD.
sky130_expected.reasoning: XM4 will charge the output node until it reaches VDD, as there is no DC path to ground.

sky130_expected.calculation: Voltage divider between pull-up (XM2, XM4) and pull-down (XM1, XM5, XM3). R_pd ~ 800 ohms, I_pu ~ 400uA -> V_OL ~ 0.3V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The strong pull-down network overcomes the PMOS loads, bringing the output close to ground but not exactly 0V due to the static pull-up current.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay = C * V / I. With C=10fF, I=400uA, V=0.9V, delay is roughly 20-50ps. Adding parasitic capacitance, expect ~100ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 is faster than 0.25um. The reported 500ps might be the total PWM pulse width, so the individual cell delay is a fraction of that.

sky130_expected.calculation: Static current when output is low is ~400uA. At 50% duty cycle, average current is 200uA. Power = 200uA * 1.8V = 0.36mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Single cell power is much lower than the full transceiver power. Dominated by static short-circuit current when the output is low.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure output voltage swing, propagation delay, and power consumption of the PWM delay cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PWM Delay Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBP VBP 0 0.99
VVN1 VN1 0 1.8
VVN2 VN2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 50p 50p 1.2n 2.5n)

XM1 N1 VDD N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 VN2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 VN1 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

Cload N1 0 10f

.control
tran 10p 10n
meas tran v_oh max v(N1)
meas tran v_ol min v(N1)
meas tran t_pd_fall trig v(VN2) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_pd_rise trig v(VN2) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran t_rise trig v(N1) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.44 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(N1) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.36 fall=1

let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power

print v_oh v_ol t_pd_fall t_pd_rise t_rise t_fall avg_power
quit
.endc
